findings.finding: The initial actual SDK admission refused METADATA_NOT_READY because the inherited root test profile disabled TaskRunRecorder. Enabled the real recorder in the hosted fixture; no forced Running metadata was introduced.

A final operator failure left an owned output OPEN. Server rejection was STALE_OWNER; client incorrectly selected lifecycle fallback only for TERMINAL_CONFLICT. Corrected exact typed-code handling, retaining authoritative final TaskRun fencing.

Async worker-entry failure completed its future outside the copied worker Context. Compensation lost the submitting API/profile, started an unwanted ephemeral server, and left output OPEN. Completion callback now runs under a copied submission Context; startup tests explicitly release the worker only after callback registration.

Required CI type analysis found two diagnostics for a private engine lifecycle protocol in public prefect.streams. Moved the same structural runtime protocol into the existing private stream-engine module. The full successor CI analysis has zero errors across 1290 files; SDK/package/recovery/legacy/kernel gates are rerun on the final protocol location.

Two existing proxy-transport unit tests failed under inherited lower-case proxy and loopback NO_PROXY values. The same bypass was reproduced from archived unchanged main. The two inspection-only fixtures now normalize both cases of their fake proxy and no-proxy variables; no production routing or runtime network settings changed. Final client regression passes.

scope: Executed exploratory negatives; successor source-bound acceptance reports carry the frozen positive sources.
